title: 第3章  小号废了，再练个小小号
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
“问那么多干什么？”林建军狠狠瞪了儿子一眼。
虽说林国栋如今身居高位，已经是装甲旅的一把手，说一不二，不过在已经退了的老爹面前，还是得乖乖夹起尾巴做儿子。
林国栋翕动了下嘴巴，把追问的话又咽了回去。
他不问，老爷子林建军反而自顾自说了起来。
“咱们林家世代从军，就算他不当兵，把香火传下去，那也算完成了家族使命。”
顿了顿，又补充道：“等他成了家，有了牵挂，也就踏实了，到时候，他就算想混吃等死在家啃老，我们也不管他，只要他不闯祸、不惹事，安安稳稳过日子，就谢天谢地了。”
“孙子这个小号废了，那咱们就再练个小小号。”
“我都安排好了，等他左脚一进门，就直接安排他去相亲！看好了直接订婚，下个月就结婚！明年一手报俩大重孙，老头子我亲自培养，全给打造成国防重材！”
林国栋听得有些傻眼，愣了半晌，抬眼看着自己的父亲：“和……谁家的姑娘？”
林建军爽朗一笑：“老李头家的孙女，知根知底，一会他到家，你来开口。”
看到老爹一脸胜券在握的模样，林国栋没敢反驳，只在心里暗暗腹诽，希望儿子别再整什么幺蛾子最好。
半个小时后。
军用的送兵大巴车缓缓停在军区家属院的门口。
熟悉的红砖墙、挂着军属牌子的院门，还有门口那棵他从小爬到大的老槐树，一切都和他离开时一模一样。
但他他妈的不想回来啊！是真不想回来！
“狗日的系统，非要等老子真的退伍了才激活，要死啊！”
“还有老爹跟爷爷，你们但凡再努力一次呢？你们打电话啊，打电话啊！扣我的户籍跟申请表啊！你们真就能眼睁睁看着我退伍？”
“真服了！”
林毅无奈的叹了口气。
当真是世事无常啊。

他看着那扇熟悉的家门，不想进，真心不想进。
但都回家了，也不可能真的不进。
得，再想办法回部队吧，系统任务摆在那里，他不可能错过这个机会。
迈步走到门前按下门铃，门很快就被
老妈王秀兰站在门后，看到他的瞬间眼眶一下就红了，快步走上前，一把抓住他的胳膊，声音里满是心疼：“儿子……瘦了。”
她抬手抹了抹泪：“妈给你做了你最爱吃的红烧肉，快进来吃。”
林毅心里一暖，所有的烦躁和急切都暂时压下去了。
跟着老妈走进家门，刚来到客厅就察觉气氛很是不对劲。
爷爷林建军坐在沙发正中央，手里端着茶杯，脸色阴沉，他进来连眼皮都没抬一下。
老爹林国栋坐在旁边的单人沙发上抽着烟，脸色同样难看，眼神里满是失望。
“回来了。”林国栋率先开口，语气冷淡：“我还以为你得在外面多晃几天才舍得回来。”
林毅张了张嘴，想说点什么，却被老妈拉了拉胳膊。
王秀兰一边帮他拿行李，一边打圆场：“爸，国栋，先吃饭吧。”
林建军依旧没说话，只是重重地哼了一声，放下茶杯起身朝着餐厅走去。
林国栋掐灭烟头也跟着起身，路过林毅身边的时候，冷冷地瞥了他一眼。
林毅心里门清，爷爷跟老爹这是生气呢。
入伍三次，退伍三次，爷爷的老战友，还有老爹的战友们知道了这件事后，绝对会无情的嘲笑两人。
但无妨，入伍三次退伍三次绝对不是最终的结果，他一定要四次入伍！
餐桌上，摆满了林毅爱吃的菜，红烧肉、糖醋排骨、清蒸鱼，全都是老妈精心准备的。
林毅没心没肺的坐下吃饭。

别说，还得是老妈做的饭香啊！
王秀兰时不时给林毅夹菜，眼神里满是心疼。
林建军与林国栋看着大快朵颐的林毅，气不打一处来。
你小子，回来了也不知道先认个错，倒是先吃起来了？
沉默了许久，林国栋放下筷子，清了清嗓子：“既然回来了，那我就把事跟你说清楚。”
“明天去相亲，你李爷爷的孙女，李舒婉，你小时候见过，他家跟咱们家绝对算的上是门当户对，你俩见过之后今年就把婚结了，明年生孩子，生完孩子之后，你想干嘛干嘛，我跟你爷爷绝对不管你。”
王秀兰连忙附和：“是啊小毅，舒婉那姑娘我见过，温柔懂事，你们在一起，肯定合得来。”
林毅眯了眯眼睛。
怪不得老爹跟爷爷能同意自己这次退伍啊，合着是觉得自己这个号废了，想要练一个小小号。
他吐出嘴里的骨头：“爸，爷爷，我想好了，我准备再次入伍，回部队去。”
相亲是不可能相亲的，打死都不可能相亲的，正好就借激活系统这件事，把这场相亲给躲过去。
一句话，瞬间打破了餐桌上的平静。
王秀兰手里的筷子“哐当”一声掉在桌上，脸上满是难以置信。
林国栋的脸色当即变得铁青，猛地一拍桌子，声音陡然拔高：“林毅！你是不是疯了？你是不是把我们所有人都当猴耍？！”
他指着林毅，气得浑身发抖：“入伍三次，退伍三次！你现在告诉我，你还要回部队？”
“你知道在军区别人都怎么说我嘛？说我培养了个好儿子啊，真把部队当自己家了，想来就来，想走就走，还有你在部队干的那些事，你自己心里没点数吗？”
“还有你爷爷，一辈子没被人戳过脊梁骨，一辈子都是抬头做人，好不容易退休了，现在都要落个晚节不保的名声了，他的那些老战友们，现在看见你爷爷都笑话他。”
“你爷爷一辈子都没犯过错，就因为你要退伍，把你档案扣下了，你爷爷懊悔了大半年，觉得对不起部队，对不起国家！”
“你现在倒好，咋滴，知道我跟你爷爷同意你退伍了之后，就觉得没意思了呗？就觉得我俩这么折腾你，你心理不服气，想折腾折腾我们呗？”
“我告诉你，你休想！你做你的春秋大梦去吧！”

王秀兰在一旁拦着，却根本拦不住。
林国栋都快气死了，额头青筋暴起，那手就一直放在皮带上，随时准备抽出来上演一出父慈子孝的名场面。
林建军也彻底黑了脸，眉头拧成了一个疙瘩：“你之前哭着喊着要退伍，说死也不留在部队，好，我跟你爸同意了，让你退伍，现在刚踏进门，就说要回去，小毅，你这孩子到底怎么想的？”
他当然知道自己这个孙子是什么性格，无非就是不想去相亲，想用回部队的方式来逃避。
但他又搞不明白，明明逃避相亲有一大堆的办法，林毅偏偏就想要回部队呢？
这不合理啊，林毅分明就是不想回部队啊。
面对老爹跟爷爷的怒火，林毅眼神格外坚定：“我没疯，也不是故意跟你们作对，我就是要回部队，不管你们同意不同意，我都要回去。”
“你！”林国栋被他气得说不出话来，指着他的手都在抖，“好，好得很！你要是敢再去入伍，我就没你这个儿子！我绝对不会同意，绝对不会让你再去丢人现眼！”
“你不要脸，我跟你爷爷还要脸呢！你，你，你看我怎么收拾你！”
“爸，我一定会再次入伍。”林毅依旧不肯退让：“就算你们不同意，我也会想尽一切办法，重新回到部队，谁也拦不住我。”
content_en:
"Why are you asking so many questions?" Lin Jianjun glared at his son fiercely.
Although Lin Guodong now occupies a high position and is the leader of the armored brigade, he still has to be a son with his tail between his legs in front of his father who has retired.
Lin Guodong moved his mouth and swallowed back his questioning words.
He didn't ask, but the old man Lin Jianjun started talking to himself.
"Our Lin family has been in the army for generations. Even if he doesn't serve as a soldier and passes on the incense, it will be considered as fulfilling the family mission."
After a pause, he added: "When he gets married and has a family to care for, he will be at ease. At that time, even if he wants to live alone and die at home to grow old, we won't care about him. As long as he doesn't get into trouble, doesn't cause trouble, and lives a stable life, thank God."
"Sun Tzu's trumpet is useless, so let's practice another trumpet."
"I have made all the arrangements. As soon as he walks through the door, I will arrange for him to go on a blind date! If we look forward to it, we will get engaged and get married next month! Next year, I will give birth to two great-grandchildren. I will personally train the old man and make them into important national defense personnel!"
Lin Guodong was a little dumbfounded when he heard this. He was stunned for a long time and looked up at his father: "With...whose girl?"
Lin Jianjun smiled heartily: "The granddaughter of Mr. Li's family knows everything about him. You can speak to him when he gets home later."
Seeing his father's confident look on his face, Lin Guodong did not dare to refute, but secretly cursed in his heart, hoping that his son would not do any more tricks.
Half an hour later.
The military bus for transporting troops slowly stopped at the gate of the Military Area Family Courtyard.
The familiar red brick walls, the courtyard door with a military sign, and the old locust tree at the door that he had grown up growing up were all exactly the same as when he left.
But he doesn’t fucking want to come back! I really don’t want to come back!
"It's a stupid system. You have to wait until I'm really retired from the army before it's activated. It's going to kill me!"
"And dad and grandpa, if you try hard one more time? You guys are calling, calling! You are taking away my household registration and application form! Are you really going to watch me retire from the army?"
"I'm so convinced!"
Lin Yi sighed helplessly.
Really everything is impermanent.
He looked at the familiar door and didn't want to enter. He really didn't want to enter.
But since they all went home, it was impossible not to enter.
Come on, let's find a way to return to the army. The system mission is there, and he can't miss this opportunity.
He walked to the door and pressed the doorbell. The door was quickly opened.
His mother, Wang Xiulan, was standing behind the door. Her eyes turned red the moment she saw him. She walked forward quickly and grabbed his arm. Her voice was full of distress: "My son...has lost weight."
She raised her hand and wiped away her tears: "Mom has made your favorite braised pork for you, come in and eat."
Ji Yi felt warm in his heart, and all his irritability and eagerness were temporarily suppressed.
I followed my mother into the house, and as soon as I entered the living room, I noticed that the atmosphere was very wrong.
Grandpa Lin Jianjun was sitting in the middle of the sofa, holding a teacup in his hand, his face gloomy, he came in without even raising his eyelids.
Father Lin Guodong was sitting on the single sofa next to him, smoking a cigarette, his face equally ugly, his eyes full of disappointment.
"Back." Lin Guodong spoke first, with a cold tone: "I thought you would have to hang out for a few more days before you were willing to come back."
Ji Yi opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but his mother pulled his arm.
Wang Xiulan helped him carry his luggage and smoothed things over: "Dad, Guodong, let's eat first."
Lin Jianjun still didn't speak, just snorted heavily, put down his teacup, got up and walked towards the restaurant.
Lin Guodong put out his cigarette butt and stood up. When he passed by Ji Yi, he glanced at him coldly.
Lin Yi felt clear in his heart that his grandfather and father were angry.
After enlisting in the army three times and being discharged from the army three times, my grandfather's old comrades and my father's comrades would definitely laugh at them mercilessly when they found out about this.
But it doesn’t matter. Enlisting in the army three times and being discharged from the army three times is definitely not the best choice.In the end, he must enlist in the army four times!
The dining table is filled with Ji Ji's favorite dishes, braised pork, sweet and sour pork ribs, and steamed fish, all carefully prepared by his mother.
Ji Yi sat down to eat heartlessly.
Not to mention, the rice cooked by my mother must be delicious!
Wang Xiulan would pick up food for Lin Yi from time to time, her eyes filled with distress.
Lin Jianjun and Lin Guodong were furious as they looked at Lin Yi enjoying his meal.
You kid, you didn’t know how to admit your mistake when you came back, but you started eating first?
After a long silence, Lin Guodong put down his chopsticks and cleared his throat: "Since I'm back, I'll make things clear to you."
"We're going on a blind date tomorrow with your Grandpa Li's granddaughter, Li Shuwan, whom you met when you were a child. His family is definitely a match for ours. After you two met, you will get married this year. You will have a baby next year. After the baby is born, you can do whatever you want. Your grandpa and I will never care about you."
Wang Xiulan quickly agreed: "Yes, Xiaoyi, I have met that girl Shu Wan. She is gentle and sensible. You two will definitely get along well together."
Ji Yi narrowed his eyes.
No wonder my father and grandfather agreed to my retirement this time. Co-author felt that his account was useless and wanted to practice a smaller account.
He spat out the bones in his mouth: "Dad, grandpa, I've thought about it. I'm going to enlist in the army again and go back to the army."
It is impossible to go on a blind date, even if you kill yourself, you can avoid this blind date by activating the system.
One sentence instantly broke the peace on the dining table.
The chopsticks in Wang Xiulan's hand fell to the table with a clang, her face full of disbelief.
Lin Guodong's face immediately turned livid, he slammed the table, and his voice suddenly rose: "Lin Yi! Are you crazy? Are you treating all of us like monkeys?!"
He pointed at Ji Yi, trembling with anger: "Enlisted three times and retired three times! Now tell me, you want to go back to the army?"
"Do you know what people say about me in the army? They say that I have raised a good son. He really treats the army as his own home. He can come and leave when he wants. Also, don't you think about the things you did in the army?"
"And your grandpa, who has never been poked in the back in his whole life. He has always kept his head high and behaved his whole life. He finally retired and now has a reputation that cannot be guaranteed. His old comrades in arms all laugh at your grandpa when they see him now."
"Your grandpa has never made a mistake in his life. Just because you were about to retire, your file was withheld. Your grandpa regretted it for most of half a year and felt that he was sorry for the army and the country!"
"You're doing well now. Why, after knowing that your grandfather and I agreed that you should retire from the army, do you find it boring? Do you think you are not convinced that we are tormenting you like this, and you want to torment us?"
"I'm telling you, don't even think about it! Go ahead and dream about your spring and autumn dreams!"
Wang Xiulan stood by to stop him, but couldn't stop him at all.
Lin Guodong was almost furious, with veins popping out on his forehead. He kept his hand on his belt, ready to pull it out at any time to stage the famous scene of a loving father and a filial son.
Lin Jianjun's face turned completely dark, and his brows knitted into a knot: "You were crying and shouting that you wanted to retire, and you said you would not stay in the army until you died. Well, your father and I agreed to let you retire. Now, as soon as you step through the door, you say you want to go back. Xiaoyi, what do you think, kid?"
Of course he knew what kind of character his grandson was. He just didn't want to go on a blind date and wanted to escape by returning to the army.
But he couldn't understand that there were many ways to avoid blind dates, but why did Lin Yi just want to return to the army?
This is unreasonable. Ji Yi clearly doesn’t want to return to the army.
Facing the anger of his father and grandfather, Lin Yi's eyes were particularly firm: "I'm not crazy, and I don't mean to go against you. I just want to go back to the army. Regardless of whether you agree or not, I will go back."
"You!" Lin Guodong was struck by himHe was so angry that he couldn't speak, and the hand pointing at him was shaking, "Okay, great! If you dare to enlist in the army again, I won't have your son! I will never agree, and I will never let you embarrass yourself again!"
"You are shameless, and your grandfather and I are still shameless! You, you, look at how I will deal with you!"
"Dad, I will definitely join the army again." Lin Yi still refused to give in: "Even if you don't agree, I will try my best to return to the army. No one can stop me."
